name: mariner
title: Mariner
description: A CV site drawn as a seaman's discharge book: a navy bookcloth cover over pale azure laid paper, and a ruled record in blue-black ink where every ship or job is a row with its trade or port in a green double-ringed oval stamp.

tokens.--font-caps: grotesque for the printed capitals: column heads, captions, cover, menu, stamps
tokens.--font-slab: slab serif for all that is written in: names, ranks, ships, dates, headings, text
tokens.--text-xs: printed column heads, captions and stamp lettering
tokens.--text-s: menu, contact lines, voyage lines, highlights, footer
tokens.--text-l: ranks and job titles, the cover title, opening sentences
tokens.--text-xxl: page titles and the name heading the CV
tokens.--leading-body: space between lines of reading text
tokens.--leading-tight: space between lines of a heading
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the small printed capitals
tokens.--color-bg: the pale azure book paper behind every page
tokens.--color-text: the blue-black ink: reading text, headings and entries
tokens.--color-muted: lighter printer's ink: heads, captions, roles, list dates, footer
tokens.--color-accent: port-office green: stamps, link underlines, Print button, focus rings
tokens.--color-rule: thin rules: column rules, writing lines, dividers
tokens.--color-rule-strong: heavy rules above each entry and the double rules of the record
tokens.--color-laid: the faint laid and chain lines in the paper
tokens.--color-gutter: shadow of the binding fold between the home page's text and its record
tokens.--color-cloth: navy bookcloth of the cover band
tokens.--color-cloth-text: cover lettering: site title and menu
tokens.--color-cloth-muted: lighter cover lettering and the ruled frame round the title
tokens.--color-cloth-accent: green mark under the current menu item, focus rings on the cover
tokens.--color-code-bg: background of code in page text
tokens.--measure: longest comfortable line of reading text
tokens.--stamp-text: widest line of lettering in a stamp; longer places stack and the oval grows taller
tokens.--space-2: tight gap; padding in the record's cells
tokens.--space-3: normal gap; side margin on a phone
tokens.--space-5: largest gap: beside the home record, above the footer
tokens.--radius: corners of code, images and the Print button (a book is square)
